# Load libraries

```{r}
# Loading libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(ggridges)
library(ggbeeswarm)
```

# Source scripts

```{r}
source("../scripts/functions/functions.R")
```

# Read data

```{r}
# Metadata
metadata <- read_csv("../data/metadata.csv")

# Olink Explore 1536 data
data_long <- read_csv("../data/data_long.csv")
data_wide <- read_csv("../data/data_wide.csv")
```

# Analysis setup

## Define subsets

```{r}
# Acute VTE
acute_vte <- "Acute venous thromboembolism"

# Post-VTE
post_vte <- "Post venous thromboembolism"

# Healthy
healthy <- "Healthy"

# ACS
acs <- "Acute coronary syndrome"

# Acute inflammatory inflammatory response
acute_phase <- c("E.coli pyelonephritis", 
                 "Pneumococcal pneumonia", 
                 "Staphylococcus aureus bacteremia", 
                 "Streptococcal soft tissue infection")

# All other cardiovascular diseases
pan_cvd     <- c("Abdominal aortic aneurysm", 
                 "Coronary artery calcification", 
                 "Acute coronary syndrome")

# All other diseases
pan_disease <- metadata |> 
  distinct(Disease) |> 
  pull(Disease) |> 
  setdiff(c(
    # Remove VTE cohorts
    "Acute venous thromboembolism", 
            "Post venous thromboembolism", 
    # Remove healthy individuals
            "Healthy",
    # Remove Pediatric diseases
    "Pediatric CNS tumor",
    "Pediatric bone tumor",
    "Pediatric retinoblastoma",
    "Pediatric lymphoma",
    "Pediatric neuroblastoma",
    "Pediatric sarcoma",
    "Pediatric kidney tumor",
    "Pediatric diffuse astrocytic and oligodendro. tumor",
    "Pediatric long COVID",
    "Pediatric systemic inflammatory disease"
    ))

# All available cancers
pan_cancer  <- metadata |> 
  filter(Class == "Cancer") |> 
  distinct(Disease) |> 
  pull(Disease)

# High risk cancers
high_risk_cancer <- c("Pancreatic cancer", 
                      "Colorectal cancer",
                      "Glioma",
                      "Ovarian cancer",
                      "Lung cancer", 
                      "Acute myeloid leukemia", 
                      "Chronic lymphocytic leukemia", 
                      "Hepatocellular cancer")
```

## Themes & pallets

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 1. Define cohorts
# ============================================================

cohort_definitions <- list(
  "Acute VTE"                   = acute_vte,
  "Post-VTE"                    = post_vte,
  "Acute coronary syndrome"     = acs,
  "Acute inflammatory response" = acute_phase,
  "Healthy"                     = healthy,
  "Cardiovascular diseases"     = pan_cvd,
  "Pan-Disease"                 = pan_disease,
  "Pan-Cancer"                  = pan_cancer,
  "High-risk cancer"            = high_risk_cancer
)

# ============================================================
# 2. Cohort order — displayed from TOP to BOTTOM
# ============================================================

cohort_order <- c(
  "Acute VTE",
  "Post-VTE",
  "Healthy",
  "Cardiovascular diseases",
  "Pan-Disease",
  "Pan-Cancer",
  "High-risk cancer",
  "Acute inflammatory response",
  "Acute coronary syndrome"
)

# ============================================================
# 3. Cohort colours
# ============================================================

cohort_colors <- c(
  "Acute VTE"                   = "#FC8D62",

  "Cardiovascular diseases"     = "#FC8D62",

)

category_pal <- c(

# ============================================================
# 4. Check that all selected cohorts have definitions and colours
# ============================================================

stopifnot(
  !anyDuplicated(cohort_order),
  all(cohort_order %in% names(cohort_definitions)),
  all(cohort_order %in% names(cohort_colors))
)

# Theme
theme_vte <- function(base_size = 16, base_family = NULL) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size, base_family = base_family) +
    theme(
      text            = element_text(size = base_size, family = base_family),
      plot.title      = element_blank(),        # remove title
      plot.subtitle   = element_blank(),
      plot.caption    = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none",                 # remove legend
      axis.title      = element_text(size = rel(1.2)),
      axis.text       = element_text(size = rel(1.05)),
      strip.text      = element_text(size = rel(1.05), face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),       # remove major gridlines
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),       # remove minor gridlines
      panel.background = element_blank(),       # clean background
      plot.background  = element_blank()        # remove plot background
    )
}
```

# Sex and Age distribution

```{r}
# Utilizing the functions defined in functions.R
source("../scripts/functions/functions.R")

# Sex distribution
p_sex <- plot_sex_distribution(
  metadata = metadata,
  cohorts = cohort_definitions,
  cohort_order = cohort_order,
  show_total = TRUE
)

p_sex

# Age distribution
p_age <- plot_age_distribution(
  metadata = metadata,
  cohorts = cohort_definitions,
  cohort_order = cohort_order,
  age_var = "Age",
  cohort_colors = cohort_colors
)

# Show individually
p_age
p_sex

# Combine; cohort labels appear on the left panel only
p_combined <- (
  p_sex |
    (
      p_age +
        theme(
          axis.text.y = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
        )
    )
) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1.5, 1))

p_combined

ggsave(
  filename = "../plots/pdf/sex_age_distribution.pdf",
  plot = p_combined,
  width = 7,
  height = 8
)
```
